correctness.rationale: Exact multiplicative sigma bound characterizes all nonnegative exponents. Thirteen finite tile colorings are explicitly listed and independently replayed using integer addition. Each tile has every 2^i3^j5^e exactly once, and exactly equal sums. All a,b in the proposed admissible region have exponent-rectangle side lengths decomposable using the verified tiles; translation preserves sums and disjointness. The converse is the largest-divisor bound. The verifier passed 13 tile certificates plus all 256 small parameter pairs. No finite extrapolation supports the infinite step.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification on the natural three-prime-support family continuing the known 2^a*3*5 classification. It establishes exact sufficiency of the intrinsic sigma(n)>=3n obstruction, supplies the sharp first new case 180, and gives a uniform constructive proof using finitely checkable weighted packets. It goes beyond known individual examples and is neither a parameter substitution nor a claim about an arbitrary slice.
